notes: Feet. Origin = front-left exterior corner of the house; +x to the right (house width), +y toward the rear deck. 'house' is the outer face of exterior walls, union of first and second floors (master wing 13'-7" first / 13'-9" second floor; entry/foyer bump to x=21'-0" stepped back 4'-10"; great room front at y=15'-7"), plus the 9" chimney projection on the right wall. 'deck' is the 9'-0" first-floor rear deck across the full width; 'ext_stair' is the 3'-0" exterior deck stair outside the left wall. Roof overhangs (~1'-0") and the front entry canopy are not included. Redrawn from owner-supplied plans; verify with the architect of record.
